module_summary: Three-requester fixed-priority arbiter implemented as a four-state FSM whose grant outputs are decoded from the held grant state.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Arbiter FSM state (idle A or granted B/C/D); decoded into grants.

anchors.name: r
anchors.why: Request vector from three devices, prioritised in next-state logic.

anchors.name: g
anchors.why: Grant vector decoded from states B, C and D.

groups.name: priority_arbiter_fsm
groups.description: Fixed-priority grant FSM holding grant while request stays high.
